canonical_requires: hash-verified G1 repaired-dataset and final acceptance receipts
a hash-verified prm_g1c_pretraining_receipt_v1 and corrected asset SHA-256
complete repaired pair-, host-, and impurity-OOF predictions

execution.reason: G3 is a server-side CPU statistical workload and must not reserve a GPU
execution.versioned_output_only: analysis writes a write-once analysis_started.json attempt lock and refuses any existing attempt lock or coverage/effect/block/family/figure/analysis-manifest output; partial runs require a new output directory

definitions.depth_class_margin: abs(depth) - 1; negative for interstitial and nonnegative for adsorbate under the IMP2D definition

extension_factor.source: IMP2D Eq. (2); XF > 2 denotes potentially unphysical reconstruction

raw_database_mapping.conv2: source-workflow numerical-quality scalar; sensitivity control only, with no physical or unit interpretation
raw_database_mapping.en1: first workflow-stage total energy; never interpreted as a coordinate snapshot or displacement
raw_database_mapping.en2: final workflow-stage total energy; provenance-only field

exact_definitions.model_edge_neighbor_set: directly read from edge_index/edge_dist in the exact source graph dataset used by the corresponding prediction (frozen legacy cleaned pickle for exploratory output; hash-verified G1 repaired graph pickle for canonical output), centered on the unique impurity; zero-displacement self interaction is absent, while nonzero periodic impurity self-images (i == j with nonzero lattice shift) are retained exactly as consumed by DefectEnvironmentEnrichment
exact_definitions.physical_host_neighbor_set: directed ASE raw-database neighbor-list entries centered on the unique impurity at cutoff 5.0 Angstrom with neighbor atom index different from the impurity index; distinct periodic images of host atoms remain separate entries
exact_definitions.neighbor_distance_mean_A: arithmetic mean of d over model_edge_neighbor_set
exact_definitions.local_abs_electronegativity_contrast: absolute impurity-minus-neighbor mean contrast of column 2 of the hash-frozen model atom-feature table over model_edge_neighbor_set; this is the exact scale consumed by DefectEnvironmentEnrichment, not raw Pauling units
exact_definitions.model_edge_periodic_impurity_self_image_: number of model_edge_neighbor_set entries whose neighbor atom index equals the impurity index; audit-only and never silently removed
exact_definitions.host_only_cn_5A: number of members of physical_host_neighbor_set; audit-only
exact_definitions.raw_graph_edge_audit: for impurity-centered entries, archive raw-minus-graph count, neighbor-index multiset equality, and the maximum absolute distance difference after deterministic sorting when topology matches; these audit quantities are not substituted for graph-native E features
exact_definitions.neighbor_distance_std_A: population standard deviation of d over physical_host_neighbor_set
exact_definitions.postrelaxation_min_clearance_A: minimum over physical_host_neighbor_set of d - r_cov(impurity) - r_cov(neighbor)
exact_definitions.signed_mismatches: impurity raw elemental property minus the arithmetic physical_host_neighbor_set mean; absolute variants are the absolute value of the signed mismatch
exact_definitions.host_slab_thickness_A: range of host-atom Cartesian positions projected onto the unit normal cross(cell_vector_0, cell_vector_1)
exact_definitions.element_properties: covalent radii from the runtime ASE table; raw Pauling electronegativity and GROUP tables from src/features.py at the run commit; valence is group for groups 1-2 and 3-12, and group-10 for groups 13-18; exact E-module electronegativity uses the frozen atom_features_ref.pth column 2 instead
exact_definitions.missing_element_property: for physical chemistry mismatches, a nonfinite covalent radius or zero-placeholder raw Pauling electronegativity is missing and is not imputed; the exact model-feature-table E contrast retains its finite encoded placeholder values because that is what the model consumed

feature_taxonomy.packing_proxy_name_rule: postrelaxation_min_clearance_A must not be called a pristine void radius

missingness_rule.at_least_0.95: main_text_eligible only when overall, adsorbate, and interstitial coverage each meet the threshold

primary_model.estimator: Huber M-estimator after weighted alternating projection of crossed host, impurity, and pair-fold fixed effects
primary_model.continuous_scaling: median-centered and divided by IQR on finite analysis rows
terms: all main-text-eligible E-module-aligned geometry features, including cn_5A, mean distance, and maximum distance
the E-aligned local absolute electronegativity contrast exactly once
primary_model.individual_contrast: adjusted 10th-to-90th percentile contrast within each incorporation class
primary_model.back_transform: for each class, set all continuous non-focal terms to their class median, set the focal term to its class q10 or q90, marginalize host/impurity/fold effects under the final Huber-IRLS weighted zero-sum constraint, predict eta = final_IRLS_weighted_mean(y) + beta dot (profile - final_IRLS_weighted_mean(design)), and return max(exp(eta)-0.05, 0); the eV contrast is high minus low and the percent contrast divides by max(low, 0.05)
primary_model.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05 across all individual feature-by-class contrasts; paper-facing effects must pass the adjusted-q gate as well as interval, magnitude, fold, and XF gates
primary_model.fold_stability: refit separately in each of five pair folds
primary_model.sensitivity: repeat after retaining only finite XF <= 2 (missing XF excluded regardless of whether abs_log_XF enters the primary model) and with declared nuisance controls

effect_gate.minimum_magnitude: absolute back-transformed predicted absolute-error contrast >= 0.10 eV or >= 20 percent relative to the low profile
effect_gate.interval: 95 percent pair-cluster bootstrap interval excludes zero
effect_gate.fold_direction: same direction in at least 4 of 5 pair folds
effect_gate.nuisance_sensitivity: direction persists after adding eligible numeric controls and crossed spacegroup/supercell fixed effects
effect_gate.language: association or correlate; never explains or causes

host_vs_impurity_analysis.outcome: sample-matched absolute host-OOF error minus absolute impurity-OOF error
host_vs_impurity_analysis.host_novelty: training-only identity-level standardized/PCA five-nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance among unique host identities using mean/std covalent radius, Pauling electronegativity, valence, area-per-host-atom, normal-projected slab thickness, 12 directed-entry-per-host-atom RDF bins spanning 0-6 Angstrom, and host-only coordination mean/std
host_vs_impurity_analysis.impurity_novelty: training-only identity-level standardized/PCA five-nearest-neighbor Euclidean distance among unique impurity elements using covalent radius, electronegativity, valence, period, and group
host_vs_impurity_analysis.identity_aggregation: each base descriptor is the arithmetic mean of finite structure-row values for one unique identity inside that fold partition
host_vs_impurity_analysis.missing_rule: for novelty only, each base feature is median-imputed from training identities and an explicit missingness indicator is appended; a feature missing for every training identity fails closed
host_vs_impurity_analysis.scaling_rule: training-identity median/IQR scaling after imputation and indicator augmentation; zero-IQR augmented columns are removed using training identities only
host_vs_impurity_analysis.pca_rule: center the train-only robust-scaled matrix; retain the smallest component count explaining at least 95 percent training variance, capped at 10 and never exceeding numerical rank
host_vs_impurity_analysis.oof_calibration: after all fold-local novelty distances exist, host and impurity novelty are each median/IQR calibrated over unique OOF identities without labels; this post-OOF identity-level calibration only makes the two distance scales comparable and never refits fold features, PCA, or neighbors
host_vs_impurity_analysis.association_model: Huber regression on the raw-eV sample-matched host-minus-impurity absolute-error gap with robust-calibrated host-minus-impurity novelty gap and incorporation class as fixed predictors
host_vs_impurity_analysis.uncertainty: 2000 host-impurity-pair multiplicity bootstrap draws with seed 20260810
host_vs_impurity_analysis.common_stability_strata: the frozen pair_cv5 test split assigns every sample to one of five common strata; host and impurity fold IDs are never assumed to align
host_vs_impurity_analysis.leakage_rule: all descriptor imputation, feature scaling, PCA, and neighbor reference fitting occurs inside the corresponding host or impurity OOF training partition; only the declared unlabeled post-OOF identity calibration is global
host_vs_impurity_analysis.claim_gate: support requires the 95 percent pair-bootstrap lower bounds of both mean host-minus-impurity error gap and novelty-gap slope to be strictly positive, with each quantity positive in at least 4 of 5 common pair folds; negative or mixed direction is non-support or contradiction, never structural-motif-shift support

case_selection.high_error: greedy top-four interstitial absolute errors requiring finite XF <= 2 and finite abs(conv2) outside the exact full-population top-one-percent set, with no repeated host or impurity; ties break by sample_index
case_selection.matched_low_error: nonpathological adsorbates at or below the adsorbate-specific 25th error percentile, matched by host family, global-population target-energy decile, impurity series, and nearest atom count; no repeated control host or impurity; ties break by absolute target difference then sample_index
case_selection.target_deciles: nine NumPy linear quantile cut points from the full 10,224-row target distribution; np.searchsorted with side=right assigns ties deterministically
case_selection.conv2_top_one_percent: exactly ceil(0.01*10224)=103 finite rows ranked by descending abs(conv2), with sample_index breaking ties; fewer than 103 finite values fails closed
case_selection.matching_fallback: none; fewer than four valid matches is a fail-closed incomplete case panel and must not be manually filled
case_selection.pathology_panel: XF > 2, the exact 103-row abs(conv2) set, and missing XF/conv2 provenance are ranked independently
case_selection.archive: write the complete eligible pool and deterministic rank keys before any rendering
case_selection.main_text_gate: a passing population P1 association and at least three host families among high-error cases

panels.a: adjusted error versus coordination or clearance, stratified by incorporation class
panels.b: covalent-radius, electronegativity, and valence mismatch contrasts
panels.c: error versus extension factor with XF = 2 marked
panels.d: host-family and impurity-series sample-weighted and identity-macro MAE

row_level_sidecar.panel_a: one sample_observation row per sample and feature for cn_5A and postrelaxation_min_clearance_A, with sample_index, raw_row_id, incorporation class, feature value, and absolute pair-OOF error
row_level_sidecar.panel_c: one sample_observation row per sample with extension_factor, abs_log_extension_factor, incorporation class, absolute pair-OOF error, XF pathology flag, and literal reference_x=2/reference_label='XF = 2'

adjusted_profile_grid.coverage_rule: build profiles only for candidates passing the frozen class-stratified main-text coverage gate; at least one candidate must pass or analysis fails closed
adjusted_profile_grid.grid: 41 linearly spaced points from the incorporation-class-specific q10 to q90
adjusted_profile_grid.profile: reuse the frozen primary Huber fit, class-specific non-focal medians, final weighted centering, and back-transform without refitting during figure construction
adjusted_profile_grid.uncertainty: pointwise 95 percent host-impurity-pair multiplicity-bootstrap intervals from the same 2000 draws; not a simultaneous confidence band
adjusted_profile_grid.panel_c_rule: retain raw extension-factor observations and the XF=2 marker; abs(log XF) is not inverted to a unique raw-XF adjusted profile

physical_figure_contract.legacy_exploratory_watermark: EXPLORATORY — LEGACY GRAPH; NOT FOR MANUSCRIPT
